guide.summaryTitle: À propos des biorythmes : formule, cycles et FAQ
guide.mathRule: Les biorythmes calculent des courbes sinusoïdales depuis la date de naissance : Physique (23 jours), Émotionnel (28 jours) et Intellectuel (33 jours) selon R(t) = sin(2πt / T).
guide.boundary: Cet outil est destiné à la réflexion personnelle et ne remplace en aucun cas un avis médical.
guide.physicalDesc: Governs energy levels, physical stamina, coordination, and resistance to fatigue.
guide.emotionalDesc: Influences mood swings, nervous system sensitivity, creativity, and empathy.
guide.intellectualDesc: Shapes analytical thinking, mental alertness, memory recall, and logical decision-making.
guide.faq1Q: Q: How are biorhythm curves calculated?
guide.faq1A: A: Each rhythm starts at birth (day 0) and cycles sinusoidally between +100% (peak vitality) and -100% (restoration phase), crossing zero at half-cycles.
guide.faq2Q: Q: Is biorhythm theory medical science?
guide.faq2A: A: No. While modern medicine studies circadian rhythms (24h internal clocks governed by the SCN), fixed lifetime biorhythms serve as a fun reflective journaling framework.
guide.faq3Q: Q: What does a 'critical transition day' mean?
guide.faq3A: A: Critical days occur when a curve crosses the baseline (0%). They signify transitional shifts where mindfulness and pacing yourself are encouraged.
guide.faq4Q: Q: Is my birth date saved or transmitted anywhere?
guide.faq4A: A: No. All calculations happen entirely in your local browser sandbox. No personal dates are stored or sent to remote servers.
